written: 2026-09-23, before any Jev call on the municipal/cantonal data and before either label file existed

data.chunks: muni/chunks.json: 75 sections from our HtmlCrawlFetcher (stadt_zuerich, ge_ville, zh_ch; 25 pages each, robots-respecting), 60 random (seed 20260923) + 15 targeted (text hits keywords of >= 2 categories); text truncated at 1500 chars (our chunk cap)
data.laws: muni/bs_laws.json: 12 Basel-Stadt laws from the official portal API; gold = API field `enactment`

gold.labellers: two independent sub-agents (fresh context, blind to each other and to Jev), same written guide; categories from registry/categories.py, junk definition verbatim from ingest/llm.py:55-57
gold.topic_gold: per (chunk, category): positive if BOTH labellers put it in primary; negative if NEITHER put it in primary or acceptable; otherwise ambiguous and excluded
gold.junk_gold: per chunk: junk flag where both labellers agree; otherwise excluded
gold.agreement: report Cohen's kappa for junk and for per-(chunk, category) primary labels

requests.M1+M2: one request per chunk, 11 noul questions: the 10 topic questions worded exactly as in the federal test T1, plus jev-mcp's substance question (src/index.ts:285-288); state = {passage: {page_title, heading, text}} in the original language
requests.M3: one request per law; extract-style choice among regex date candidates (jev-mcp wording, src/index.ts:1030-1036); field description fixed below

decision_rules_fixed_in_advance.topics_R1: predicted = {top category} if its probability >= 0.10, else none (the rule that scored best on federal law)
decision_rules_fixed_in_advance.topics_R2: predicted = every category with probability >= 0.5 x top, if top >= 0.10, else none (multi-label variant)
decision_rules_fixed_in_advance.junk: predicted junk if substance < 0.3 (jev-mcp's hard-coded skip threshold)
decision_rules_fixed_in_advance.dates: correct if the picked candidate's ISO date equals gold; if gold is not among candidates, correct only if none_of_them
decision_rules_fixed_in_advance.date_field_description: The date on which this enactment, as originally adopted, took effect ('wirksam' / 'in Kraft'); not the date of decision or publication, and not the date of a later amendment

report: overall and split by random vs targeted, by language (de/fr), and for chunks with >= 2 gold primary categories; the costly error for junk is content wrongly flagged as junk
human_spot_check: 10 chunks drawn with seed 424242 after scoring, shown to the user with both labellers' labels and Jev's output
